mines.mine_notes: FS (May 2024, technical report filed Jun 28, 2024): after-tax NPV5% US$884M (C$1,208M), IRR 14%, payback 5.7 yrs at US$1,975/oz Au, US$4.05/lb Cu, US$23/oz Ag. 22-year LOM; LOM payable 5.4 Moz Au, 381.8 Mlb Cu, 9.45 Moz Ag; avg annual payable 244,600 oz Au, 17.3 Mlb Cu, 446,700 oz Ag (256,200 oz/yr Au yrs 1-5). LOM AISC US$1,109/oz; initial capex US$1,074M; sustaining capex US$276.6M; strip ratio 3.1:1. Reserve grades: 0.49 g/t Au, 0.058% Cu, 1.0 g/t Ag (0.59 g/t AuEq). Recoveries: Au 92.7%, Cu 91.8%, Ag 91.9%. Former operating mine being restarted. FY2025: no production or revenue; net loss C$39.4M; company renamed Troilus Mining Corp. post-FY.
